subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up preserve the current `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` and node-approval boundaries while fixing Android advertising/A2UI defects, or intentionally change the camera/location command exposure contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both real command implementations and deliberate gateway/app gates; automation should not decide to broaden that boundary from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run live Android proof and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` opt-in.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden camera or location command exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after proof
options.body: If live proof shows independent causes, split camera, location, and A2UI into narrower owner-reviewed follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run live Android proof and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily Android app behavior plus sensitive device-command exposure, and the Android README names obviyus as the Android app maintainer.
